thread:
clare: Heads-up — the observability quickstart's embedded dashboard presets are showing "tokens" as the cost unit instead of USD when you select 'cost breakdown'. Caught this while testing the sample app.

miguel: ah thanks. which preset? the `latency-vs-cost` one?

clare: yes, latency-vs-cost and cost-over-time. Steps to repro: 1) import preset 2) set timeframe 7d 3) switch metric to cost -> shows 'tokens' label.

sara: ugh. likely a copy/paste from the embeddings example. can you add a screenshot and the minimal repro in the PR?

clare: will do. opened a quick PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4281 — fixes label and the unit conversion note. also updates the YAML snippet in the quickstart `dashboards/presets/latency-cost.yml` to include `unit: USD`.

alex: looping in @jamal for console UX change? jamal — will this affect the presets API shape? if so we may need a small compatibility note.

jamal: thanks @alex. No backend API change — presets use `display_unit` already, but docs had `unit` leftover. safe to just update docs. quick look 👍

doc-bot: docs PR 4281 added 3 files, modified 1 file. CI: docs build passed. linkcheck failed on one internal anchor.

clare: yep linkcheck failure is to `/docs/console/observability#cost-breakdown` — anchor changed to `#cost-and-latency`. I pushed a fix to PR.

miguel: can someone review the SDK snippet? the quickstart embeds a JS snippet that uses old `createDashboard` signature. small change: `createDashboard({preset: 'latency-cost'})` -> `createDashboard({presetId: 'latency-cost'})`.

sara: I'll patch the snippet and run the local example.

clare: if all good can we merge before EOD? release window tomorrow morning will pick up docs site.

alex: +1 from me, just update the PR description to mention anchor fix and SDK snippet change. I'll approve after that.

clare: done — PR description updated. thx everyone :rocket:
